description: mode=attest: a C2PA sidecar manifest per sealed claim (by claim_id, claim_ids, slug for a whole page, or cid+span) whose hard binding is the SHA-256 of the exact quoted bytes, with the source as ingredient, the licence (CMI) and the page seal as assertions, signed by this node or a mounted CA chain; tier=logged also appends it to this node's RFC 6962 transparency log and returns the inclusion proof and signed checkpoint; priced per receipt, charged once for the batch. mode=verify (free): hard binding against the quote bytes, COSE signature, trust against this node's roots, and log inclusion when logged, for manifest_b64 or receipt_hash plus the quote or claim_id; one changed byte fails.

quote.description: verify: the exact text the receipt should bind

receipt_hash.description: verify: a receipt stored on this node

name: attest
title: Citation receipts: attest (0.0100 signed, 0.0400 logged) or verify (free)
